Deep dive: Logpoint or conditional breakpoint

Log or pause on a condition

Conditional breakpoint

  • Pauses when the condition is true
  • You read Scope and Call Stack

Logpoint

  • Never pauses
  • Prints to the Console on every call

Log when pausing changes the timing.

Deep dive: DOM change breakpoint types

Three DOM change breakpoints

  1. 1Subtree modifications: a child changes
  2. 2Attribute modifications: an attribute changes
  3. 3Node removal: the node is removed
